name: WipEout Rewrite
description:
wipEout Rewrite is an open-source reverse-engineered C port of the iconic 1995 futuristic anti-gravity racing game wipEout for the Sony PlayStation. It brings the high-octane techno racer natively to modern PCs.

Features:
- Native 64-bit execution delivering silky-smooth 60+ FPS anti-gravity racing
- High-resolution widescreen rendering with increased draw distance and enhanced textures
- Accurate anti-gravity vehicle physics and airbrake handling mechanics
- Full modern gamepad and racing controller support with customizable button mapping
- Includes all original championship tracks, weapon pickups, and iconic techno soundtrack
